evidence.quote: Does Ringwood require a CCO inspection upon resale of a home? No, but you ARE required to have the smoke alarm devices inspected.
Ringwood does not have a Certificate of Continued Occupancy program for the sale of a residential home [Ordinance 40-17.3 (b)] .
An existing building that conformed to the code when it was built is not required to conform to newer building codes.

The Building Department is located at 60 Margaret King Avenue, 1st floor Phone 973-962-7880 Fax 973-962-7823 Email building@ringwoodnj.net Michael Hafner Construction Official/Building Subcode Official/Zoning Officer/Code Enforcement Officer

resale_co.notes: The Building Department's 'Buying or Selling a Home?' page says Ringwood has no Certificate of Continued Occupancy program for the sale of a home (Ordinance 40-17.3(b)); only the smoke alarm and carbon monoxide alarm certificate from the Fire Prevention Bureau is needed. An optional letter confirming no CCO is required costs $15.00 by written request. The page also says underground oil tanks in use and not leaking may stay, and that septic and well questions go to the Health Department (973-962-7079) through an OPRA request. Technical Assistant to the Construction Official: Audrey Schaffner.

requirements: All smoke alarms must be less than 10 years old and UL listed; battery-only alarms must be sealed 10-year units; NEST battery alarms are not accepted
Homes with 110-volt interconnected smoke alarms must keep that system working and cannot switch to battery alarms
Older homes without hardwired alarms need at least one battery smoke alarm on every level, including the basement and a habitable attic
Any low-voltage fire alarm system must be active and monitored by an alarm company at the inspection
Smoke alarms in the hallway within 10 feet of all bedroom doors; basement alarm within 10 feet of the bottom of the stairs, not in the stairwell

Alarms mounted on the ceiling (or on the wall 4 to 12 inches from the ceiling), at least 4 inches from the wall-ceiling corner and at least 3 feet from steamy bathrooms, ceiling fan blades and HVAC supply vents
Carbon monoxide alarms on every level with sleeping areas, within 10 feet of bedroom doors (not inside bedrooms), less than 7 years old

Homes with solar panels, generators or battery backup need a durable printed label (letters at least 3/8 inch) within 18 inches of the main panel and the outside meter; handwritten labels are not accepted
Fire extinguishers are no longer required
Dogs must be contained when the inspector arrives

authorities.how_to_apply: Fill out page 1 of the Fire Prevention Bureau application (Application for Change of Residential Occupancy, revised 07/2026) and bring or mail it to the Ringwood Municipal Building, 60 Margaret King Avenue, with the fee in exact cash or a check payable to the Borough of Ringwood. Fees count from the next business day after the application and fee are received. A failed inspection needs a new application and fee.

evidence.quote: Scott Conley, Fire Official (973) 475-7132; sconley@ringwoodnj.net Office Hours: Wednesdays & Thursdays from 8:30am - 4:30pm

Inspections are performed by the Borough's Fire Official every Wednesday from 10:00am to 2:00pm. Certificates are issued on site at the time of inspection, and are valid for six (6) months or until another change in occupancy occurs, whichever comes first.
STEP 2: Mail or bring your application to the Building Department, along with the applicable fee in exact cash or check payable to Borough of Ringwood.
Application for Change of Residential Occupancy Revised 07/2026

Application for inspection is made at the Ringwood Municipal Building, Fire Prevention Bureau in person or by mail. A fee is required for each compliance certificate inspection, to be paid with exact cash or check payable to the Borough of Ringwood.
Inspections are performed on Wednesdays between 10:00 am and 4:00 pm. Specific appointment times are not provided or available.
The State of New Jersey has repealed the law requiring fire extinguishers in 1 and 2 family dwellings to obtain a certificate of Smoke Alarm and Carbon Monoxide Compliance. No longer required.
LEAID: 1611-001 Enf Auth. Municipal Fire Official Scott R Conley Phone (973) 475-7132 ... Email sconley@ringwoodnj.net

fire_cert.notes: The Fire Prevention Bureau page says inspections are Wednesdays 10:00am to 2:00pm and to bring the application to the Building Department, while the current application form (revised 07/2026) says Wednesdays 10:00 am to 4:00 pm and to apply at the Fire Prevention Bureau (Municipal Building, 1st floor); no set appointment times are given. A change of occupancy without a certificate can bring a penalty of up to $500.00 to the seller. The form fax is (973) 962-6028. An older 5/2021 version of the form (same $50 / $85 / $140 fees, still listing fire extinguishers) also sits on the site. Ringwood's volunteer fire companies (Erskine Lakes, Ringwood Vol Fire Co #1, Skyline Lakes) handle emergency response only.
